page.notes: The "«" at the end of the last line is printed and is kept as printed. The line-end hyphens "Põ-", "subscri-", "quo-" (in "quorum"), "profiteren-" and "aucto-" are kept as printed. "detraheret" has no printed hyphen at the line end, so it is written whole. "Põ" is read as Pomponius with a tilde over the o. The tilde over "sumebãt" and "subscribã" is read as a tilde over a. The dot-like marks at the lower left and the small marks on the right edge are stains and are not transcribed.
